transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm here because my mind just keeps going blank. At the worst times, really. I'll just be at work, looking at the road-closure forms, or holding the stop-slow paddle, and... I suddenly can't remember the steps. Things I've done for years. It just... yeah. It goes empty.
When your mind goes blank, is it usually happening when you feel very stressed or anxious?
I don't... I don't really know. I haven't noticed if I am. It just sort of... happens.
When this happens, do things around you feel unreal or distant?
No... I don't think so. It's not really like that. It's just... empty.
Do you ever find that you cannot remember important personal information about yourself?
No, um... I know who I am. My name, where I live, all that. It's just... the tasks at work that slip away. Not me.
When your mind goes blank, do you feel suddenly very anxious right at that moment?
No... I don't think so. I don't feel much of anything when it happens. It's just... a blank.
Did this start after something very frightening or upsetting happened to you?
No... I don't think so. Nothing frightening happened. It just... started.
Outside of work, do you also forget how to do familiar everyday tasks?
No... not really. I can still do things at home just fine. It's mostly just... what I already told you.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying about many different things in your life?
No, not really. I don't... worry that much. I just... I don't know. No.
Have you been forgetting recent conversations?
No... I don't think so. If someone talks to me, I remember it. It hasn't really been a problem.
When this happens, is it that you cannot remember how to do the work task?

Yeah... I guess. It's just... my mind goes blank. Like I'll be looking at the road-closure forms, or... the stop-slow paddle. And I suddenly can't remember the steps. Things I've done for years. It just... goes blank.
Are the same work tasks always the ones that go blank for you?
I don't really know... I haven't noticed if it's always the same ones. It just... happens. I haven't really kept track.
When your mind goes blank at work, can you still remember what the task is for, even if you cannot remember the steps to do it?
I don't... I'm not really sure. I guess I know I'm supposed to be working, but... I don't know. I haven't really thought about it like that. It's just... everything kind of stops.
When this happens, do you still recognize the tools or forms in front of you?

I... yeah, I know what they are. I recognize the paddle. But... like I said, I'll be looking right at the forms or the paddle, and... I just can't remember what to do with them. The steps are just gone.
When your mind goes blank at work, do you still know what day it is?
I... I guess so. I'm not really thinking about what day it is when that happens. I just... I don't know. I haven't really paid attention to that.
When your mind goes blank at work, do you know what day it is?
I... didn't you just ask me that? Like I said... I don't really know. I'm not thinking about the day of the week when it happens. I just... I don't know.
Outside of those moments at work, do you have trouble learning new things?
I... I don't think so. I haven't really tried to learn anything new lately. I just... do my job and go home.
When this happens, do you still remember what the next step should be if someone tells you to do it?
I... I suppose so. If someone tells me what to do, I can usually follow along. I just... I don't really think about it. I just try to get through the shift.
Have you ever suddenly forgotten how to do another familiar skill, like driving or making tea?
No... I don't think so. I can still drive to my spot just fine. I haven't really noticed anything like that.
When your mind goes blank at work, do you still remember your coworkers’ names?
Yeah... I know their names. It's just... the tasks that slip away. Not the people.
After someone reminds you of the steps at work, do you remember them later on your own?

Not always... no. It just keeps happening. That's... why I came in, actually. My mind just keeps going blank at the worst times. I'll be looking at the road-closure forms, or... the stop-slow paddle... and suddenly I just can't remember the steps. Even though I've done them for years. It just... goes away again.
